notes: A video loop card. Pick a clip once in Control Panel, Options, Video - a file on this PC, a direct video link, or a YouTube video - and any panel with Show video switched on plays it on a loop. Always muted, because a panel that made noise…

A YouTube link works even though a YouTube page is not a video file. The app recognises watch, share and shorts links and plays them as an embed; pasting one into an ordinary video player would have shown a black box and no explanation.
You can choose whether the clip fills the frame and crops, or shows the whole picture against black.
A file that has moved, or a link that will not play, says Video unavailable rather than sitting as a black rectangle.
